releases.title: Releases
releases.intro: Change & Release Center: what is live per environment, the draft being prepared, readable configuration diffs, four-eyes approvals, scheduled publishing and one-click rollback. Every action is audited.
releases.siteContext: Drafts, versions and the impact preview refer to {site}
releases.switchSiteHint: Change the site in the workspace switcher.
releases.noSiteText: Create your first site to publish a tracking configuration.
releases.migrationMissingText: The approvals and scheduling tables (migration 0010) are not applied to this database. Published versions are shown; drafts, approvals and schedules are not.

strip.lintErrors: {count, plural, one {# blocking issue} other {# blocking issues}}
strip.approvalsPending: {count, plural, one {# approval pending} other {# approvals pending}}
strip.versions: {count, plural, =0 {no versions} one {# version} other {# versions}}

draft.title: Draft for {environment}
draft.intro: The open draft becomes version {version} when it is published. Changes are prepared in AI Setup, in Destinations and in the Data Quality Inbox; this page reviews, approves, schedules and publishes them.
draft.emptyText: Nothing is waiting to be published. Prepare a change in AI Setup, connect a destination or accept a fix from the Data Quality Inbox — the draft appears here for review.
draft.author: Prepared by {name}
draft.invalidText: The draft does not match the configuration schema and cannot be published. Discard it and prepare the change again.

lint.errors: {count, plural, one {# blocking issue} other {# blocking issues}}
lint.explain: Blocking issues come from the configuration lint (policy, public ids, JSONLogic). Warnings do not block publishing.

draft.noChanges: The draft is identical to the live version.
draft.criticalText: This change touches consent, a critical event, a destination or the kill switch in production. Four-eyes approval applies.
draft.signalsInfo: In {environment} these signals are informational; four-eyes applies to production.

schedule.title: Scheduled publication
schedule.pendingWorker: The worker publishes it within a minute of the scheduled time.

reasons.signing_key_missing: the worker has no configuration signing key
reasons.draft_not_open: the draft was no longer open
reasons.draft_changed: the draft changed after it was scheduled
reasons.approval_invalid: the recorded approval was no longer valid

evidence.title: Test evidence
evidence.intro: Live Test Lab runs since this draft was opened. Run a journey in the test environment before publishing to production.
evidence.empty: No test run since the draft was opened.
evidence.unavailable: Test runs are not available (migration 0007 not applied).

fourEyes.title: Four-eyes approval

state.single_publisher: Not available: you are the only member who can publish. The release is recorded as a single-person release.
state.pending: Waiting for a second member: requested by {name} {time}.
state.stale: The last approval refers to an older state of the draft. Request a new review.
state.rejected: The last request was rejected. Change the draft and request a new review.
state.missing: A second member with publish rights has to approve this change before it can be published or scheduled.

fourEyes.publishers: {count, plural, one {# member can publish} other {# members can publish}}
fourEyes.requestDialogText: A second member with publish rights reviews the change summary below and approves or rejects it. The request refers to the draft as it is now; further edits need a new request.
fourEyes.decideDialogText: You approve or reject exactly the changes listed below. A rejection needs a reason; the decision is audited.
fourEyes.reasonHint: Required for a rejection, optional for an approval.
fourEyes.ownRequest: You requested this review; another member has to decide.

reasons.critical_event: A critical event stops or changes its trigger
reasons.consent_weaker: Consent gets weaker (region mode, advanced consent mode or Global Privacy Control)
reasons.destination_purpose_weaker: A destination needs less consent than before
reasons.marketing_destination_added: An advertising destination starts receiving events

actions.publishDialogText: The draft becomes a signed, immutable version and is live for the SDK and the worker within about a minute. This cannot be undone, but a rollback to any earlier version takes one click.
actions.singleAcknowledge: I confirm this critical change alone; no second member can approve it in this organization.
actions.scheduleDialogText: The worker publishes the draft at the chosen time. It refuses to publish if the draft changes after scheduling or the approval becomes invalid; you see the reason here.
actions.scheduleHint: Between {min} minutes and {max} days from now, in your local time.
actions.discardDialogText: The draft is archived, pending approval requests are withdrawn and a schedule is removed. Live traffic is not affected.
actions.rollbackDialogText: The currently live version v{active} is replaced by v{version} within about a minute. The open draft stays untouched; the rollback is audited.
actions.rollbackDialogNoActive: Nothing is live in {environment}; v{version} becomes the live version within about a minute. The rollback is audited.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.not_found: The draft or version no longer exists.
errors.not_open: The draft is no longer open.
errors.lint: The draft has blocking issues; fix them before publishing.
errors.approval_required: This critical change needs a four-eyes approval first.
errors.approval_pending: An approval request is already pending.
errors.approval_rejected: The last approval request was rejected; change the draft and request a new review.
errors.acknowledge_required: Confirm the single-person release to continue.
errors.self_approval: You cannot approve your own request.
errors.stale: The draft changed since the request; it needs a new request.
errors.reason_required: A rejection needs a reason (at least 3 characters).
errors.signing: Publishing is not configured on this deployment (no configuration signing key).
errors.schedule_invalid: Enter a valid date and time.
errors.schedule_too_soon: Choose a time at least {min} minutes from now.
errors.schedule_too_far: Choose a time within the next {max} days.

impact.title: Change Impact Preview
impact.intro: What publishing this draft changes, derived from the diff and from measured data of the last {days} days in {environment}. Volumes are measurements, not forecasts; a missing measurement stays unknown.

events.caption: Events the draft adds, removes, enables, disables or changes

destinations.title: Affected destinations
destinations.caption: Destinations the draft adds, removes, enables, disables or changes

consent.title: Consent purposes
consent.weaker: Less restrictive than the live version

volume.title: Estimated volume
volume.unmeasured: {count, plural, one {# enabled event without measurement} other {# enabled events without measurement}}: {events}
volume.empty: No events measured in the last {days} days for this environment — the volume after the change is unknown.
volume.unavailable: Aggregates are not available on this database.
volume.stale: Last aggregate {time}; newer events may not be counted yet.

plan.title: Plan limits
plan.noLimit: No fixed event cap in this plan
plan.projected: Measured baseline ≈ {projected} events per month ({share}% of the limit)
plan.projectedUnknown: No projection without a measured baseline
plan.threshold: The measured baseline already crosses the {threshold}% warning threshold of the plan.

dq.title: Expected data-quality effect
dq.intro: Rule-based; each line names the rule that fired. This is not a guarantee: the pipeline measures the real effect after publishing.
dq.no_changes: The draft does not change the live configuration.
dq.critical_event_stopped: Critical event {event} stops: {measured, select, yes {{accepted} accepted events in the window} other {no measurement}} will no longer be captured.
dq.event_removed_open_issues: {event} stops with {issues, plural, one {# open data-quality issue} other {# open data-quality issues}}; stopping the event does not resolve them.
dq.destination_stopped: {destination} stops receiving events ({measured, select, yes {{delivered} deliveries in the health window} other {no health measurement}}).
dq.destination_failing_stopped: {destination} stops; it failed {errorRate}% of recent deliveries, so those failures stop with it.
dq.destination_no_mappings: {destination} is enabled without event mappings and receives nothing.
dq.conversion_browser_only: {event} is browser-only; without a server-verified source duplicates and missing values are likely.
dq.conversion_without_authoritative_source: {event} goes to advertising destinations without a server-verified source (blocking).
dq.consent_weaker: Consent gets weaker: more events may be processed before an explicit signal where the region policy allows it.
dq.kill_switch_on: The kill switch stops all collection for this environment.
dq.kill_switch_off: The kill switch is released; collection resumes.
dq.allowed_hosts_reduced: Events from {hosts} are rejected after publishing.
dq.new_event_unmeasured: {event} is new; its volume and quality are unknown until events arrive.
dq.lint_errors: {count, plural, one {# blocking lint issue prevents} other {# blocking lint issues prevent}} publishing.
dq.no_rule_fired: No rule fired for this change. Verify the effect in the Live Event Explorer after publishing.
